name: embeddable-widget-lead-capture-platform
description: Embeddable lead-capture widgets with a hardened cross-origin submission path, collaborative lead inbox, and funnel analytics.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project unit-contracts --project unit-runtime --project unit-server
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project unit-contracts --project unit-runtime --project unit-server
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project integration-database --project integration-server
